title: Engineering System Software
description: System software principles, components, usage, protection, and their relation to hardware and engineering systems. Modern operating systems characteristics and engineering applications; portable operating system interface standard. Requirements, design, development, and maintenance of complex software for portable devices, real-time and multi-processor systems.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ECE 476, ECE 356, CENG 356.
May not be counted for credit towards a Computer Science degree program.
